run_spm_decode_piece: run the sentencepiece decoder to decode piece tokens from an input file using a model
run_spm_decode_id: run the sentencepiece decoder to decode integer IDs from an input file using a model
review_main: review the main function that parses args and decodes sentencepiece tokens or IDs line by line
review_decode_pieces: review the decode function that uses SentencePieceProcessor DecodePieces to reconstruct text from piece tokens
review_tok2int: review the tok2int helper that remaps <<unk>> tokens to integer 0 for ID decoding
